content: We need to find template that reproduces Still-Gennari reaction retrosynthesis. The target molecule is not given explicitly. The input from previous step 'make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4' gave answer [] meaning applying some template gave no precursors. We need to find template that when applied to the molecule below (provided as available input data). But we don't have the molecule SMILES. The description: Still-Gennari reaction forms Z-alkene from aldehyde and phosphonate ester. The forward reaction forms C-C double bond and carboxylic ester, breaks C-P, C-C, C-O bonds, and alkyne triple bond to single bond. So retrosynthesis: target is an alkene with ester? The molecule likely is something like C=CC(=O)OC? That's an acrylate? Actually Still-Gennari yields (Z)-alkene with ester group attached to carbonyl? The product is an alkene with an ester attached to one carbon (beta-alkoxy). Example: R-CH=CH-COOR. That's an alpha,beta-unsaturated ester. The SMILES C=CC(=O)OC is methyl acrylate (CH2=CH-COOCH3). That matches C-C double bond and carboxylic ester formed. So target is methyl acrylate. We need template that when applied retrosynthetically gives aldehyde + phosphonate ester. The template likely involves breaking C-O bond of ester and forming C-P bond etc. The search gave many templates but not matching. We need to find template ID that matches criteria: functional_groups_broken include C-P, C-C, C-O; functional_groups_formed include C-C double bond, carboxylic ester; bonds_order_changed includes C≡C to C-C single? Actually triple bond changed to single. So we need to include bonds_order_changed maybe "C-C (3.0->1.0)"? Not sure format. Let's try search with bonds_order_changed.
